tutorial.dragTitle: Move panel · Fine-tune with arrow keys
tutorial.steps.welcome.title: Welcome to Launch Elbow
tutorial.steps.welcome.body: This guided two-wave exercise uses fixed modules and tower slots. We will build the first cast sequence together.
tutorial.steps.tower.title: Open the refractor first
tutorial.steps.tower.body: A tower is a runtime node for modules. Selecting it opens the Arc Workshop with its slots, energy, and targeting controls.
tutorial.steps.frost-drag.title: Drag Frost into slot 1
tutorial.steps.frost-drag.body: A modifier does not fire on its own. It changes the next projectile found to its right, and dragging expresses exactly where it belongs.
tutorial.steps.frost-drag.instruction: Drag from the yellow source to the yellow target
tutorial.steps.pulse-drag-first.title: Drag Pulse into slot 2
tutorial.steps.pulse-drag-first.body: Projectiles are the carriers a tower actually fires. Slots execute left to right, so the program now reads “Frost → Pulse.”
tutorial.steps.pulse-drag-first.instruct: Drag the Pulse module into slot 2
tutorial.steps.first-program.title: The first program is valid
tutorial.steps.first-program.body: The summary shows energy per cycle and projectile count. Frost is now consumed by the Pulse to its right, producing one slowing pulse per shot.
tutorial.steps.close-first-workshop.body: The configuration is saved. Close the workshop during combat for a full view of paths, enemies, and projectile effects; click the tower to reopen it.
tutorial.steps.close-first-workshop.inst: Click the close button in the workshop header
tutorial.steps.build-second-tower.title: Build a second tower
tutorial.steps.build-second-tower.body: One tower cannot reliably stop the entire Spark wave. Launch Elbow has a second node across the path for crossfire.
tutorial.steps.build-second-tower.instru: Click the highlighted empty node to build
tutorial.steps.second-pulse-drag.title: Install Pulse in the new tower
tutorial.steps.second-pulse-drag.body: One Pulse remains in the inventory. Drag it into slot 1 so both towers can attack.
tutorial.steps.close-second-workshop.bod: Both towers can now attack. Close the workshop, launch wave one, and watch them cover different path segments.
tutorial.steps.close-second-workshop.ins: Click the close button in the workshop header
tutorial.steps.launch-one.title: Launch the first signal wave
tutorial.steps.launch-one.body: Sparks are fast but fragile. Watch the slowing Pulse give each tower more time to attack.
tutorial.steps.wait-first-wave.title: Observe the module combination
tutorial.steps.wait-first-wave.body: The tutorial continues automatically after this wave is defeated.
tutorial.steps.ensure-tower.title: Reopen the tutorial tower
tutorial.steps.ensure-tower.body: Wave two extends the program you just built. Click the first tower to reopen its Arc Workshop.
tutorial.steps.move-pulse.title: Move Pulse from slot 2 to slot 3
tutorial.steps.move-pulse.body: The trigger must sit between the modifier and carrier. Drag the installed Pulse to empty slot 3 to free slot 2.
tutorial.steps.move-pulse.instruction: Drag Pulse from slot 2 to slot 3
tutorial.steps.trigger-drag.title: Drag Impact into slot 2
tutorial.steps.trigger-drag.body: A trigger wraps the next projectile to its right. Only when the carrier meets the condition does it release the following payload.
tutorial.steps.static-drag.title: Drag Mine into slot 4
tutorial.steps.static-drag.body: Static projectiles do not fly like normal rounds. A trigger must deploy them onto the battlefield, where they wait for enemies.
tutorial.steps.static-drag.instruction: Drag Mine into slot 4 to complete the payload
tutorial.steps.final-program.title: Read the payload relationship
tutorial.steps.final-program.body: The final order is “modifier → trigger → carrier projectile → static payload.” The PAYLOAD trace below the workshop visualizes this nesting.
tutorial.steps.close-final-workshop.body: The full trigger chain is saved. Close the workshop to watch the Pulse impact, Mine deployment, and enemy proximity trigger.
tutorial.steps.close-final-workshop.inst: Click the close button in the workshop header
tutorial.steps.launch-two.title: Launch the second signal wave
tutorial.steps.launch-two.body: Kites join this wave. Slow the pack with Pulse and watch the deployed Mine trigger as enemies approach.
tutorial.steps.launch-two.instruction: Click “Launch signal” to finish the tutorial
tutorial.steps.ensure-wrong-tower.title: This is not the tutorial tower
tutorial.steps.ensure-wrong-tower.body: The second phase must continue editing the starting tower used in wave one. Close this workshop and the correct node will be highlighted.
